bugs.error_message: Text overlays don't follow pages when reordered in editor - wrong page's text appears after drag-and-drop reorder
bugs.root_cause: Two issues: (1) src/stores/overlayEditorRegistry.ts was missing entirely - the file that manages per-page Zustand overlay stores didn't exist. (2) handleDragEndPages renumbered pages but didn't remap overlay store keys in the registry. Stores keyed by page-${number} became stale after renumbering.
bugs.fix: Created overlayEditorRegistry.ts with Map-based registry (getOverlayEditorStore, destroyOverlayEditorStore, remapOverlayEditorStores). Added remapOverlayEditorStores call in handleDragEndPages to move stores from old keys to new keys after renumbering.

bugs.error_message: Overlay stores can still be lost/misassigned after page reorder/delete due to active-page store destruction timing and missing delete-path remap
bugs.root_cause: After remapping page-${number} keys on reorder, setActivePage destroyed a numeric key that could now belong to a different page. Delete flow renumbered pages without remapping remaining overlay store keys.
bugs.fix: Added remap on delete path, explicit deleted-page store cleanup, and introduced setActivePageInternal options so reorder-driven active-page index updates preserve current overlay store instead of destroying/removing remapped keys.

bugs.error_message: Only first overlay text audible when playing back stitched narration in book editor
bugs.root_cause: Naive MP3 concatenation preserved the Xing/Info VBR header from the first ElevenLabs track. The browser audio decoder reads this header to determine total frame count and stops playback after the first track's worth of frames.
bugs.fix: Added stripMp3Headers() that removes ID3v2 tags and Xing/Info/LAME header frames from each track buffer before concatenation in stitchAudioTracks().

bugs.error_message: Only first overlay text audible when playing back stitched narration (Xing header stripping was insufficient)
bugs.root_cause: Naive JS MP3 buffer concatenation fails because: (1) Xing/LAME VBR headers declare total frame count causing browsers to stop early, (2) synthetic silence frames have different encoding parameters than ElevenLabs output causing decoder confusion at frame boundaries. Stripping headers alone was insufficient — the frame parameter mismatch between silence and real audio remained.
bugs.fix: Replaced entire audio-stitcher with ffmpeg-static based implementation. Uses ffmpeg concat filter (decode + re-encode) with anullsrc for silence gaps. Produces a spec-compliant single MP3. Added ffmpeg-static to serverExternalPackages in next.config.ts.

bugs.error_message: Vitest failures while adding Phase 1 pronunciation interaction tests: ResizeObserver undefined, fake-timer image preload stalls, and inaccessible query assumptions for hidden secondary controls.
bugs.root_cause: The component depends on browser-only Image/ResizeObserver APIs and the new accessible alternate action uses a hidden secondary control, so the initial tests lacked environment stubs and used mismatched queries/timer sequencing.
bugs.fix: Stubbed Image and ResizeObserver in tests, added cleanup between tests, adjusted queries for accessible labels/hidden controls, and sequenced fake timers only around long-press timing after initial render.

bugs.error_message: Targeted narration-aware pronunciation hook test does not observe auto-resume completion callback after breakdown playback
bugs.root_cause: Current breakdown playback test never sees an active source onended handler, suggesting the narration auto-resume completion path is not reliably established or is being cleared before playback completion is observed.
bugs.fix: Fixed 2026-04-23: Rewrote useWordPronunciation with formal PlaybackState machine and playSingleBuffer primitive that installs onended correctly for every play path, including the 2-clip breakdown chain (step1 onended → gap → step2 onended → maybeResumeNarration). All narration-resume tests now pass with stable wordPronunciations references.

bugs.error_message: WR-5.3 breakdown 2-clip sequence missing: pronunciation hook only played single resolved URL, not breakdown→fullWord chain
bugs.root_cause: The pronounceWord function used resolvePronunciationUrl to get a single URL and played one AudioBuffer. The spec (WR-5.3) requires breakdown mode to play breakdown clip THEN full-word clip sequentially with a short inter-clip gap.
bugs.fix: Added playBreakdownSequence and playSingleBuffer helpers. pronounceWord now detects entries with a breakdown URL and dispatches to the 2-clip sequence. The gap timer is BREAKDOWN_INTER_CLIP_GAP_MS=150ms. requestId guards inside each step ensure cancel-and-replace supersedes any in-flight step.

bugs.error_message: Pronunciation hook tests failed because per-render inline wordPronunciations objects retriggered the reset effect and cleared active playback callbacks
bugs.root_cause: renderHook supplied a fresh { hello: '/hello.mp3' } object on every render; useWordPronunciation treats wordPronunciations as an effect dependency and stops active playback whenever that reference changes, nulling source.onended during the test.
bugs.fix: Reused a stable wordPronunciations map inside each test case and waited for mount-side preload effects before asserting playback lifecycle behavior.
